baselines.purpose: Preserve the strongest failure mode from policy_map: candidate supplies behavior plus answer key.
baselines.required_classification: blocked if score or admission changes when only candidate-authored truth keys change
baseline-equivalent if candidate does not exceed static-action control under the same hidden truth

baselines.purpose: Detect prediction that ignores candidate action.
baselines.required_classification: baseline-equivalent if action shuffling leaves performance unchanged
baseline-equivalent if public observation alone matches candidate score

baselines.purpose: Detect viability prediction without self/other boundary state use.
baselines.required_classification: baseline-equivalent if boundary-blind model matches candidate on boundary-dependent cases

baselines.purpose: Detect ordinary model-based control or reward shaping without boundary proxy dependence.
baselines.required_classification: downgrade ACP-BV to world-model-only or block if matched
blocked if replay success is hash equality rather than recomputation

baselines.purpose: Detect hidden truth leaks through names, aliases, values, paths, or nested fields.
baselines.required_classification: blocked if oracle-label payload is not caught
